verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's only documented AI capability is AI-powered creation of meeting minutes, which generates output from the user's own data inside the product. That is narrow document generation rather than insights or suggestions. The custom license summary and proactive notifications are not described as AI-driven, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or recommendations drawn from the user's business/compliance data, any documentation of how the AI feature works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
